admission.justification: Spans tool_results.py, server.py, and stdio_probe.py, is guarded by two regression tests, and prevents placeholder DictOutput outputSchemas and duplicate structuredContent from bloating every tool listing and response.

applicability: Every MCP tool registered through AgentsRememberMCP.add_tool returning bare dict, dict[str, Any], or dict[str, object], plus stdio_probe._parse_server_info.
conditions: structured_output is not explicitly forced True on the tool registration.
exclusions: Typed BaseModel or other non-generic structured return tools, which continue to advertise outputSchema and emit validated structured_content.
statement: Generic dict[str, Any] and dict[str, object] tools advertise no placeholder DictOutput outputSchema and omit duplicate structuredContent on the wire while typed BaseModel tools continue to support structured output.
title: Generic dict tools omit placeholder DictOutput schema and structuredContent
